§6Centrifuge§f

§aSecond-tier ore processor with higher yields - and the earliest renewable mercury source!§f

The §bCentrifuge§f is the next tier of ore processing after the Shredder. It draws §e4 kHE/s§f with a §e100 kHE§f buffer, taking §e10 seconds§f per operation. Two upgrade slots support speed, efficiency, or overdrive.

§6Crafting§f (Assembly Machine):
§b•§f §e4×§f Polymer Bar, §e8×§f Steel Plate, §e4×§f Copper Plate, §e1×§f Analog Circuit Board.
§b•§f Centrifuge Element (Assembly Machine): §e4×§f High-Speed Steel Plate, §e4×§f Titanium Plate, §e1×§f Motor.

§6Processing§f:
§b•§f Redstone Ore → §e6×§f Redstone + §e1×§f Drop of Mercury + Gravel.
§b•§f Redstone Crystals → §e9×§f Redstone + §e2×§f Drops of Mercury.

§ePS:§f The Centrifuge is the earliest renewable source of §bMercury§f, essential for §bDesh§f production. Redstone is cheap and easy to farm - run it through a Centrifuge for a steady mercury supply!
